name: Lumenfield
tagline: Complete 14-page Lumenfield system with the original typography, native geometric illustrations and full source page sequence.

palette.description: Original source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, lines, diagrams and all page backgrounds.

typography.style: Exact published Slides theme font families League Gothic and Lato with original static source faces embedded. Source sizes, weights, nested emphasis, tracking and frame geometry are retained.

best_for: Cultural festivals, exhibitions, launch events, visitor routes, programmes and partner presentations.
avoid_for: Dense financial tables, lengthy research reports, or large paragraphs that cannot fit the source text frames.
